scope: Theorem 1.2 (A fixed moment with a degree saving) of the manuscript “A strict four-row permanent inequality and permutation moments” (preprints/A-strict-four-row-permanent-inequality-and-permutation-moments-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 238 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1fc78f640d9422a5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There exist an even integer r ≥ 2 and η > 0, independent of N, such that for every dyadic N and every λ ⊢ N, Dλ Tr BN (λ)r ≤ D1−η λ . (2) Consequently there is an absolute integer q for which the total-variation distance of q independent forward sweeps from uniform tends to zero as N → ∞, uniformly over the starting deck.
